0022600211.text: The 1-9 Milwaukee Bucks, on a six-game losing streak, visit the 5-4 New York Knicks, who have won three straight, in the Bucks' 11th game of the season. Milwaukee is 1-5 at home and 0-4 on the road and sits 15th in the East and 5th in the Central, six games back, while New York is 3-2 at home, 2-2 on the road, and 3rd in the Atlantic, three games back. Kel'el Ware (ankle sprain) and Tyler Herro (knee bruise) are day-to-day for Milwaukee and are both game-time decisions, Josh Hart is out with illness for New York, and the teams have not met yet this season; their last meeting was a 127-98 Knicks win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026, and the Bucks lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2.
